text_block_list.text: It's Gold City's second summer camp. This time last year, she was feeling tense, but now…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Hey, can I go straight to the beach after I leave my stuff?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm really itching to go for a run.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'll be up against two insanely fast runners in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to it. I want to become stronger and win.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Just talking about it is giving me a serious urge to run. Let's go, Trainer!
It looks like this summer camp is off to a blazing hot start!
